# pantechdynamics_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the record sets of a Pantech DNS zone, by name then type, including the apex SOA and NS records Pantech DNS manages (managed = true). Narrow the list with type or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every MX record set of a zone. Leave type and name out to list them all.
data "pantechdynamics_dns_records" "mail" {
  zone_id = "dnsz_06ggf2abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw"
  type    = "MX"
}

output "mail_servers" {
  value = flatten(data.pantechdynamics_dns_records.mail.records[*].values)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Id of the zone (dnsz_...).

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only record sets with this name relative to the zone, such as "www" or "@".
- `type` (String) Only record sets of this type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, NS, PTR, or SOA.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone id, followed by the filters used.
- `records` (Attributes List) The record sets, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `allow_private` (Boolean) Whether private addresses are allowed.
- `comment` (String) The note on the record set.
- `fqdn` (String) The fully-qualified name, without a trailing dot.
- `id` (String) Id of the record set (dnsr_...).
- `managed` (Boolean) True for the apex SOA and NS records, which Pantech DNS manages and which cannot be changed.
- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone; "@" is the apex.
- `status` (String) "pending", "active", "deleting" or "failed".
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live, in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `values` (List of String) The values, in the canonical form the DNS server stores (host names end in a dot).
- `version` (Number) Version of the record set.
